description: At night Roncesvalles keeps the pilgrims' silence — the Gothic Collegiate Church of Santa María standing dark among the beech forests of the Pyrenees, its spire catching only moonlight, a few warm windows glowing in the hospice where the first walkers of the Camino Francés rest. No lights flood the stones; the village of twenty inhabitants sleeps at nine hundred metres, the bell having tolled after nightfall.
